description: List every channel group in the AcuiQ point catalogue with its acupoint count and page URL – the 14 classical meridians plus the extra-point and auricular groups the catalogue files points under. Descriptions and five-element associations are returned where recorded, which is currently for almost none of them. Priced at $0.50, paid with a Stripe shared payment token (SPT), single use over MPP (Machine Payments Protocol): send the credential at params._meta["org.paymentauth/credential"]. It is the whole catalogue in one call – for ONE point use get_point, which is free, and every other tool here is free too.
name: get_meridians
title: List meridians
